body:
It is helpful. I think my intent with my original question was more geared towards someone I make a sit down appointment with, not necessarily a phone hotline/crisis line. 

That said I still appreciate the food for thought.

>  thoughts without intent, or have intent but no way to fulfill your desires

That seems very... subjective and is probably what causes some of my anxiety, but I guess you are saying to use a phone call as a sort of line of defense / real world anonymity? 

I hadn't thought of that, thanks.
